releases.body:
### Added

- Support OpenCode V2 while preserving V1 compatibility

---

Full changelog: https://github.com/ozandogrultan/opencode-ember/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0

### Breaking changes

- Remove /keepwarm and heartbeat reporting (#10) _(breaking)_

---

Full changelog: https://github.com/ozandogrultan/opencode-ember/compare/v0.4.3...v1.0.0

### Fixed

- **keepwarm:** Stop describing the timer as warming the cache
- **state:** Never write without acquiring the shared state lock

---

Full changelog: https://github.com/ozandogrultan/opencode-ember/compare/v0.4.2...v0.4.3

### Fixed

- **keepwarm:** Fail closed without background provider calls or config mutation
- **keepwarm:** Eliminate session forking and use zero-cost session keepalive

---

Full changelog: https://github.com/ozandogrultan/opencode-ember/compare/v0.4.1...v0.4.2

### Fixed

- **keepwarm:** Preserve always mode and support partial cache hits

---

Full changelog: https://github.com/ozandogrultan/opencode-ember/compare/v0.4.0...v0.4.1
